subject: proj-dy
title: PROJ.DY.------PRIN.INFO.
description: Diagram in WAM-32, the page where Braxton names the post-Webern/post-Cage juncture as 'the dissolution of the composite vibrational alignment of western culture' and reads serial music as connected simultaneously to the western source-initiation thrust *and* to the source-transfer junction of world creativity. (C)PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) is crossed with PRI-INFO (primary information; title abbreviates as PRIN.INFO): the diagram poses that under post-Cageian conditions, projectional dynamics have to be re-grounded by re-engaging primary information — but the routes are constrained. PROJ-DY is fed by ALT-F (alternative functionalism), PART (participation), and AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) — three entry points marking what could *push* projectional dynamics toward re-grounding. PROJ-DY then outputs to PRI-INFO, POL-DYM (political dynamics), AFL-DT (affinity dictates), and RE-ST (restructuralism); POL-DYM further branches into INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). The structural claim: the move toward primary information cannot bypass political dynamics — restructuralism, information affinity basis, and progressional continuance are all gated by the political-dynamics layer. This is Braxton's diagrammatic version of his prose claim that the post-Webern juncture is consequential because of what it forces on the *meta-structure*, not merely on technique.
